skills.title: P4b: the 46 skills and the agents re-pointed to docs/ and kb.mjs v2
skills.units: kb.harness.skills-and-agents (the content half: every skill and agent body true to the tree), kb.harness.truth-sweep (the lines this lane rewrites stay true)
skills.scenarios: skills-and-agents-O1, skills-and-agents-O3 (keep green; they exist from the harness lane)
skills.brief:
Every skill under .claude/skills/ and agent under .claude/agents/ must read true for a reader who works through docs/ and kb.mjs: site/**.html page paths become docs/**.md, data-kb-* attributes become frontmatter keys / section facts / {level=…} suffixes (see docs/reference/page-rules.md and tools/src/migrate/dialect.md), kb.mjs v1 surface calls become the v2 surface (tools/src/kb/spec.ts: register → level; new --kind principle|design|theme needs --group <area>, --order is the place in the area). The shape the harness lane gave each skill (Use when / Not for, gap → numbered steps → Done means) stays; the harness-shape and route gates must stay green.
SPLIT every change by when it becomes true. TRUE NOW → commit it: docs/ paths for READING (docs/**.md exists today as build output), kb.mjs read commands that v1 and v2 share, plain-word fixes, the stale 'a hook runs a check after each edit' lines, dead links. TRUE ONLY AFTER THE CUTOVER → held: 'make all && make check' → 'make gen && make validate'; editing docs/**.md or docs/data/*.json as the source; kb.mjs v2-only flags; the retirements kb-verify (→ gate-red + gate-triage), kb-hub (hubs generated), kb-site-ui (→ site-component), kb-design-relationships (regroup → kb.mjs link --group); dropping gate-red's 'Not for a legacy make check step … kb-verify' boundary; the harness cutover notes on page-audit, site-audit and site-component '# claim-ok' markers. Every cutover note in plans/harness-optimize.md 'Wave-1 merges and cutover notes' that names a skill or agent file (kb-author.md:41,81; kb-explain/SKILL.md:25,91,162,222; kb-add/SKILL.md:55; kb-intake/SKILL.md:103; kb-design-requirements, kb-edit, kb-explain 'make all && make check') is either committed (if true now) or in the held patch — none is dropped.
Do NOT edit links to .claude/rules/html5-authoring.md: the authoring lane renames that rule and rewrites every link to it. Do not edit .claude/rules/**, CLAUDE.md files, docs/**, or tools/**.

steps.title: inventory every stale line and hand out batches
steps.prompt: Read every file under .claude/skills/ and .claude/agents/ and the cutover notes. Build a re-point table (old phrase → new phrase, now or held) and write it to /private/tmp/kb2-skills/repoint.md. Hand out batches of about five skills each (one family per batch where families exist; agents as one batch), each naming its files, the table rows that apply, and every cutover note line that lands in its files. Commit nothing unless you fixed the table's own tooling; git status stays clean.
steps.batches: an array of {files: string[], family: string, rows: string[], notes: string[]}

steps.title: re-point one batch of skills
steps.prompt: Apply the TRUE-NOW rows to your batch's files in the worktree. For every TRUE-AFTER-CUTOVER change, write the file's full post-cutover version (now-edits plus held edits) to /private/tmp/kb2-skills/held/<repo-relative path> — do not put held edits into the worktree file. A retired skill's held version is an empty file named <path>.deleted plus, for its successor skill, the absorbed content in the successor's held copy. Keep each skill's shape (Use when / Not for, numbered steps, Done means).

steps.title: assemble the held patch, prove the branch green, commit by family
steps.prompt: Review the fan-out's edits (git diff) for consistency with /private/tmp/kb2-skills/repoint.md; fix anything half-done. Build plans/wave2/held/skills.patch from the held copies (git diff --no-index against each worktree file, paths rewritten to a/ b/ repo paths; .deleted markers become deletions); prove it with git apply --check on a clean copy of your head. Run make validate, make check, bash tests/run.sh. Commit one commit per skill family plus one for the patch (exact paths). Report which files and lines the patch holds.

verify.prompt:
## Truth of every re-pointed line
For each changed skill and agent (git diff be783f5 -- .claude/skills .claude/agents): every path, command, flag and count it now states must exist in the tree at the lane head (run the command where it is read-only). A line that is true only after the cutover but was committed is a finding; so is a cutover note naming a skill or agent file that is neither committed nor in plans/wave2/held/skills.patch. Apply the patch in your own worktree: it must apply cleanly and every line it adds must name something the cutover creates (make gen, kb.mjs v2 flags, docs/ as source).

authoring.title: P4b: markdown-authoring.md, TONE ids, permissions.allow
authoring.units: kb.harness.scoped-rules (rule frontmatter, the authoring rule citing rule ids), kb.harness.self-check (C10: permissions.allow)
authoring.scenarios: scoped-rules-O1, self-check-O1 (keep green; extend each if the rename or the allow list changes what it asserts)
authoring.brief:
Rename .claude/rules/html5-authoring.md to .claude/rules/markdown-authoring.md (git mv). Its rules cite the rule ids of docs/reference/page-rules.md (PAGE-001…, KB-0nn) instead of restating them; its path scope names docs/**/*.md. BEFORE the cutover the pages are still generated from site/**.html, so the HTML contract stays true and needed: keep the HTML-writing guidance in the renamed file under one clearly marked section 'Until the cutover: the HTML source' (path scope keeps site/**/*.html until then), and put the version that drops it — the file as it reads after the cutover — in plans/wave2/held/authoring.patch. tone.md: TONE-001…009 anchors exist already (harness lane); keep them stable (style-pattern-doc links them), check every TONE row names what decides it; the cutover-only edits (drop the site/**/*.html glob; the 'Cut on sight' sentence about PLAIN_WORDS / make all → add the word to docs/data/glossary.json) go in the held patch. Rewrite every link and mention of html5-authoring.md repo-wide (root CLAUDE.md, directory CLAUDE.md layers, docs/concepts, skills, agents, hooks, gates, tests) to the new name — link-only edits in skills and agents (the skills lane owns their other lines). root CLAUDE.md: only the link text changes; keep its word budget.
.claude/settings.json permissions.allow, the owner's answer: the read-only and repo-script commands the harness names — Bash(node --check:*), Bash(node --test:*), Bash(bash tests/run.sh), Bash(node .claude/skills/kb-harvest/harvest.mjs:*), Bash(node .claude/skills/site-extract/structure.mjs:*), Bash(node .claude/skills/kb-fact-check/eval-check.mjs:*), Bash(node .claude/skills/kb-fact-check/merge-staged.mjs:*), Bash(node .claude/skills/kb-fact-check/rollup.mjs:*), Bash(jq:*), Bash(comm:*), Bash(sort:*), Bash(wc:*), Bash(ls:*), Bash(grep:*), Bash(find:*), Bash(git grep:*), Bash(git blame:*), Bash(mkdir -p tmp/designs/). NOT sed, node -e, git mv, git config, gh issue, gh api, and no write command. Record the left-out commands and why in docs/concepts/working-in-this-repo.md or wherever self-check-C10 is documented, and make the self-check gate (or its test) hold the list: every command the harness names is allowed or on a recorded prompt-kept list.

steps.title: markdown-authoring.md, tone.md, every link, the held patch
steps.prompt: Do the rename, the rule-id citations, the 'Until the cutover' section, tone.md, every link, and plans/wave2/held/authoring.patch (git apply --check clean on your head). Scenario scoped-rules-O1 stays green.

steps.title: permissions.allow and its check
steps.prompt: Add permissions.allow from the brief, the prompt-kept list with reasons, and the check that holds both (self-check-C10). Scenario self-check-O1 stays green; add a test that fails when a harness file names a command on neither list.

learning.title: P6b: prerequisite card, hub status chip, level badge in the Astro site
learning.units: kb.learning.prerequisites (the built-site card), kb.learning.maturity (the built-site half: hub chip, status meta, manifest and payload status), kb.pagedata (level meta), kb.site.components (LevelBadge placement)
learning.scenarios: learning-O3, maturity-O1 (the built-site half; the gate half is the frontmatter gate's test from the relations lane — extend that test, do not duplicate it), learning-O1 (keep green)
learning.brief: Work only in the Astro site (site/src/**, site/astro.config.mjs if a plugin needs registering) and the tools/src code that feeds it (pagedata, gen-site-*), never in site/**.html, site/assets or scripts/. The prerequisite card: on a page whose record in docs/data/prerequisites.json has requires / related entries, a card lists them (data-requires / data-related hooks on class-free elements per the two-layers rule; labels, definitions and routes from that file). The hub chip: a hub entry for a page whose status is draft (or any status other than stable) carries a chip naming it; a stable page none. The level badge: LevelBadge exists — it must sit under the H1 and the page's <prefix>:level meta must show the declared level; the draft's <prefix>:status meta, manifest entry and search payload status read draft. Tokens only (the token gate), hooks queried and emitted (site-hooks gate), portability pass clean. make site-build and make site-roundtrip (RT-2) green; RT-2 must not be weakened — if the card adds text RT-2 reads, extend RT-2's knowledge, never skip it.

steps.title: card, chip, badge, metas, with their scenarios
steps.prompt: Build the three features, wire them, and add learning-O3 and maturity-O1 (built-site half) as tests named by id over a built sandbox (follow how the site lane's scenario tests build one; see tools/src/lib/site-fixtures.ts). Finish with make validate, make site-build, make site-roundtrip, make check green.

verify.prompt:
## The built pages, looked at
In your own worktree run make site-build, then serve site/dist (npx serve or python3 -m http.server under /private/tmp) and open a page with prerequisites, a draft page and its hub in a headless browser (npx playwright, already a site dependency if present; otherwise read the built HTML): the card lists the right records with working links, the chip shows on the draft entry only, the badge sits under the H1, light and dark themes both legible. Every defect with the page URL and the element.

noise.title: P7 copy half: the five site noise gates over make site-build's output
noise.units: kb.noise.formatter, kb.noise.absence-gate, kb.noise.accessibility, kb.noise.page-audit, kb.noise.post-build, kb.site.build-command (the five site-gate lines)
noise.scenarios: absence-gate-O1, accessibility-O1, formatter-O1, page-audit-O1, post-build-O1, two-layers-O1, noise-O1 and build-command-O1 (write both; where one needs a measured budget, the test reads the placeholder and is marked to re-check at P7)
noise.brief: Copy from the kit (/Users/oleksandrderechei/git/claude-code-marketplace/tmp/cookbook/kit), with the usual renames: site-format (the formatter, --check and unflagged), check-site-bundles (the absence gate: classic kb.js, no module bundles, chrome skip-marked, knowledge region class-free), check-site-a11y (static accessibility), check-site-axe, and site-shots (tools/src/site-shots.ts). Wire each as a site gate over make site-build's output the way the site lane registered its site gates (read docs/data/gates.json rows with the site-build run place, the Makefile site-build target and tools/src/run-gates.ts), with all five pieces each. Every budget, byte ceiling, chrome fingerprint and warning band is a placeholder written as a named constant or data field marked 'measure at P7' (e.g. null with a note) — NEVER copy the kit's numbers: they measure another site. A gate reading a placeholder reports it and does not fail on it. Dependencies (axe-core, a headless browser) only if the kit's gate truly needs them; install scripts stay denied. The page-audit reader script is the one page-audit skill runs; point that skill at it only if the skill already names it (the skills lane owns skill bodies). If a gate finds real defects in today's built site, fix them at their root in site/src (tokens, markup) — unless the fix is a budget, which waits for P7.

steps.title: copy and wire the five gates
steps.prompt: Copy, rename and wire the formatter, absence, a11y and axe gates and site-shots; placeholders for every measured number; five pieces each; make site-build prints their summary lines.

steps.title: the noise scenarios by id, and today's built site through them
steps.prompt: Add every owed scenario as a test named by its id over a sandbox. Run make site-build twice and diff site/dist between the runs (post-build-O1/noise-O1 idempotence); fix at the root anything not idempotent. Finish with make validate, make site-build, make check green.
